Regulatory Compliance for Pharmaceutical Industry#

Aurore K. Amrit

May 15, 2025

2 min read

M15 Guideline Compliance#

While not mandatory in academic settings, SPARCED integrates key principles from Section 3: Model Evaluation of the ICH M15 guideline to support model verification and validation, aiming to bridge the gap between academic modeling practices and the regulatory expectations of the pharmaceutical industry. This implementation focuses on enhancing model transparency, traceability, and documentation quality.

To facilitate compliance, SPARCED provides structured documentation templates and helper tools that guide users through the process of recording essential modeling decisions. These include data selection, transformation, and imputation steps, as well as the identification of key assumptions and evaluation of scenario plausibility. Users can generate much of the required documentation automatically via the command-line interface, with minimal manual input.

Although SPARCED does not enforce compliance through automated validation pipelines—preserving flexibility for academic users ; it offers a robust foundation for industry-aligned modeling workflows. Version tracking, clean data management practices, and built-in support for sensitivity and data analysis further strengthen the model evaluation process.

As the M15 guideline continues to evolve, SPARCED will adapt accordingly, with future support potentially extending to additional regulatory frameworks (e.g., ICH E6), depending on community and industry engagement.
